fields.statement: QA at 89bc7981 with a build of the branch in a scratch git repo (RHIZA_* unset, own HOME): ran the docs/agents.md commands by hand. rhiza guide ls and rhiza guide build print the topics; rhiza guide install --agent claude writes the skills to ~/.claude/skills/ and --project to .claude/skills/. The by-hand example rhiza add question export-size-cap --field statement="Do exports need a size cap?" exits 0 and writes the node into the current change set; the agent write-back path rhiza apply <file> --json with an add write exits 0 with a JSON entry. grep finds rhiza apply <file> --json in step 3 of the loop. go test -trimpath ./internal/doclinks/... ok, and make self-check in a clean worktree at HEAD exits 0 (warns only on old unclaimed main commits). The owner's approval is left to sign-off.

QA at 89bc7981 with a build of the branch: rhiza run send-back --help shows rhiza run send-back [<run>] --note <note>, matching the page's new example; in a scratch repo rhiza run send-back --note "The retry loop needs a cap" and rhiza run approve both parse and exit 2 with 'works on a run waiting at a sign-off step: no runs yet', as documented. rhiza run request-changes --help and rhiza describe run.request-changes --json exist as the page's fallback paragraph says. go test -trimpath ./internal/doclinks/... ok and make self-check in a clean worktree at HEAD exits 0. The owner's approval is left to sign-off.

QA at 89bc7981 with a build of the branch in a scratch repo: rhiza workflow new bugfix and rhiza workflow check bugfix succeed; rhiza change new "Totals are wrong on the invoice page" --workflow bugfix exits 0 and rhiza change show lists Workflow: bugfix; rhiza change workflow --clear prints that the dispatch rules choose again, and rhiza change workflow bugfix pins it again, all exit 0. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(custom-workflows-doc|docs-)' passes (GOTMPDIR outside the repo). The owner's approval is left to sign-off.
